screen_model: NMC1015 (10-15) human NUT carcinoma cells with BRD4-NUTM1 fusion
library_design: Targeted tumor-suppressor CRISPR-KO library; approximately 500 genes and 10 sgRNAs per gene
treatment_contrast: 200 nM JQ1 versus matched DMSO for approximately 17 days; resistance enrichment
screen_replication: Three replicate pairs reported; replicate unit not specified
quantitative_asset_locator: Supplementary Table S1 contains gene-level ranks, fold changes, p-values and FDR; no guide-by-sample counts
rights_basis: Article and supplement are CC BY-NC 4.0; no raw-data asset was located for a separate rights assessment
validation_source_locator: Figure 4C and Methods: two RB1 sgRNAs with controls and JQ1 dose response in NMC797, a model distinct from the NMC1015 screen
curator: Independent Codex literature reviewer; per-study outcome mapping withheld
notes: Independent review agrees on V1: follow-up used NMC797 rather than the NMC1015 screen model, and target-specific loss was not explicitly documented.

screen_model: hTERT-RPE1 human epithelial cells expressing Cas9
library_design: TKOv1 genome-wide CRISPR-KO library at least 600-fold representation
treatment_contrast: 3 nM doxorubicin (IC25) versus water control for 14 days; sensitization depletion
screen_replication: Methods state triplicate, but the public raw-count matrix contains A/B pairs only for T0, vehicle and doxorubicin
analysis_method: Filtered guide log2 fold-change followed by mean gene score
quantitative_asset_locator: Supplementary Dataset EV3 contains 91,320 sgRNA rows with T0 A/B, T14 Vehicle A/B, T14 Dox A/B plus gene scores
rights_basis: Article and Supplementary Dataset EV3 are CC BY 4.0; attribution is required
validation_source_locator: Mechanistic SHLD1 experiments use different models or endpoints and do not match the RPE1 doxorubicin contrast
curator: Independent Codex literature reviewer; per-study outcome mapping withheld
notes: Independent review found a public six-sample raw-count matrix in Dataset EV3, but SHLD1 follow-up did not test the RPE1 doxorubicin contrast; it remains nonqualifying.

library_design: Human GeCKO library A with 65,383 sgRNAs and approximately 3 guides per gene
treatment_contrast: 3 uM cisplatin versus vehicle for 30 hours followed by recovery to confluence; resistance enrichment
screen_replication: Four replicate cultures per condition with 2 million cells each
analysis_method: Bowtie2 and htseq counting, DESeq2 guide analysis, mean gene fold-change and Fisher combined p-value
quantitative_asset_locator: Supplement Tables 5 and 6 contain differential sgRNA results and gene-level ranks; no sample-level raw counts were found
rights_basis: The PMC record does not provide an open license for the source data; ORCS MIT applies only to ORCS output
validation_source_locator: Figures 1-3 and Methods: two MSH2 shRNAs with non-targeting control, Western confirmation and matched cisplatin assays in MGH-U4 and 253J
curator: Independent Codex literature reviewer; per-study outcome mapping withheld
notes: Independent review agrees on V2: two MSH2 shRNAs, perturbation confirmation, matched cisplatin response and controls in MGH-U4; no rescue.

library_design: SLICE genome-wide library with 77,441 sgRNAs targeting 19,114 genes
treatment_contrast: 20 uM CGS-21680 versus vehicle during a 4-day restimulation; CFSE-low proliferating cells selected
screen_replication: Two matched donor blocks (D5 and D6), each with vehicle/CGS-21680 by dividing/nondividing bins; eight relevant SRA runs
analysis_method: MAGeCK analysis of proliferating cells under CGS-21680 versus vehicle
quantitative_asset_locator: SRP158611 has 24 amplicon runs; only S17-S24 map to this contrast. Table S6 contains separate vehicle and CGS MAGeCK outputs
rights_basis: SRA access is public, but redistribution terms and a verified sample-to-contrast map are not yet recorded
validation_source_locator: Figure 6 and Methods: ADORA2A and FAM105A tested with two sgRNAs in two donors under matched CGS-21680 proliferation assays; target-specific editing confirmation not reported
curator: Independent Codex literature reviewer; per-study outcome mapping withheld
notes: Independent review agrees on strict V1 because target-specific editing confirmation was not reported. The eight relevant SRA runs require a donor-blocked treatment-by-bin interaction.

library_design: TKOv3 genome-wide library with 70,948 targeting sgRNAs and 142 controls
treatment_contrast: AZD6738 at IC20 versus DMSO for approximately 20 population doublings; serial endpoints through day 21
analysis_method: DrugZ and BAGEL analyses of longitudinal guide abundance
quantitative_asset_locator: Supplementary Table 1 contains DrugZ gene scores and Table 2 guide-level RNASEH2 results; no raw count matrix or FASTQ accession found
rights_basis: The PMC record does not provide an open data license; the article states remaining data are available from authors
validation_source_locator: Figures 1-2 and Methods: individual sgRNA plus Western and orthogonal shRNA evidence for RNASEH2A/B with matched AZD6738 response in 293A; no rescue
curator: Independent Codex literature reviewer; per-study outcome mapping withheld
notes: Independent review agrees on V2 for RNASEH2A/B using independent or orthogonal perturbations with confirmation and matched AZD6738 response; no rescue.
